items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had the greatest gurus in the world: Irving Green and Steve Ross

ctx.x: Every one. I had to pay $300,000 to get them back on “Sanford and Son,” but I got it. $300,000. Marty Bandier. I said, “Great. We don’t have to talk to each other.” But I gave them all back. I gave Marvin Hamlisch his too, because it’s a legacy. I understand that. I said, “No, I understand.” It’s 40 years or something that Horace – I gave them all back. Because we learned early, if you don’t have ownership – that’s what I learned the hard way – if you don’t have ownership – I was forced to get into the business,…

Let me ask you something else, because another area that people don’t talk about, where you were taking chances before anybody else was doing that – I’m thinking now of Patti Bown. I’m thinking of Melba.
